summary.name: Google Labs
summary.one_liner: Google Labs is Google's hub for early-access AI experiments and prototype tools, several of which have later become Google products.
use_cases: try experimental AI tools before public release
build simple games from a text description
evaluate and test AI models and prompts
turn speech into polished written text
learn new material through an AI tutor-style tool
build apps and websites with AI coding help
summary.what_it_does: The page is a directory listing many Google AI experiments, each with a short description and a link to try it, join a waitlist, or learn more. Examples include Playground (describe a game and generate it), Stax (an AI evaluation toolkit for testing models and prompts), Jules (an asynchronous coding agent), and Learn Your Way (content turned into a tailored learning experience). Research-oriented experiments such as Literature Insights and Hypothesis Generation are also listed. A section maps former Labs projects to current products, including Gemini (formerly Bard), Google Flow (formerly VideoFX), Gemini Notebook (formerly Project Tailwind), Google Flow Music (formerly ProducerAI), and Google AI Studio (formerly MakerSuite). The page does not state pricing for the listed tools.
notable: Hub listing many experimental Google AI tools with try-it or waitlist links
Shows graduated projects and their current product names (e.g. Project Tailwind to Gemini Notebook)
Includes research tools such as Hypothesis Generation and Computational Discovery
caveats: Experiments are prototypes and may be limited, waitlisted, or change without notice
Some listed tools require joining a waitlist before access
Page does not state pricing for individual experiments
